fullchain_eps_systematic.note: systematic full-chain inefficiency (CKF) measured at the 8 other revert points (3-5 keV, where the V4-6 CKF fraction exceeds 5 %); the 31 numpy-A2 points may overestimate eps by up to about this factor (the loss is likely smaller at <= 2 keV, where CKF stealing is below the 5 % revert threshold); applied here only as an ESTIMATE of the systematic on eps, not to any limit; no exclusion either way

investigation.verdict: statistics + measurement-noise draws; no merge/bookkeeping bug; identical inputs and identical noise model (ACTS vs numpy smearing); deep-rung pass/fail is set by the noise draw, which A2FC fully re-draws, so the deep-rung paired comparison is effectively unpaired. Numpy A2 22/200 at R14 is high, A2FC 4/200 low, against a replica expectation of >~10-11/200 (eps ~ 0.05; only numpy quirk noise was re-drawn, the ACTS quirk-noise draw was never replicated). At E500 3 keV the only identified full-chain-specific loss is row 268 (CKF stole 46/83 quirk hits; 1/64 = 1.6 % at R04; net R04 64 -> 61). At the other 8 revert points the paired R04 comparison shows a systematic one-sided full-chain loss (84/20 discordant, p ~ 1.6e-10; r_fb x 0.87): a real CKF-driven inefficiency, not noise.
investigation.p_tag: ESTIMATE; somewhat unusual; no mechanism found; "statistics" is a conclusion by exclusion (fresh ACTS-seed quirk replicas not run)

investigation.consequence: no fix; C12FC_v1 stands; deep-rung / fallback eps carry large statistical uncertainty (few passing events); the CP interval is the full statistical uncertainty (noise draws are part of it); in addition a full-chain systematic on the numpy-A2 eps (fullchain_eps_systematic)

P2_verdict.m_Q: No measurement of m_Q at PU 200; only qualitative handles ("partial"). M_est = MET cosh(eta)/(beta gamma)_ToF is a pair-mass proxy (M_QQbar >= 2 m_Q). Pooled median 2.26 m_Q at PU 200 (850 events with M_est defined), just above the 2 m_Q threshold (no PU: 2.46 m_Q); 0 events below 1.5 m_Q without PU; at PU 200 29 % below 1.5 m_Q and 19 % below 0.5 m_Q (PU-induced low cluster from in-time BTL hits). The medians order the four E masses, but the per-event spread is huge and the median/m ratio is species-dependent. No m_Q fit, no t_est, no sensitivity.json.
P2_verdict.Lambda: Only through the epsilon window (lower edge 1.0-1.2 keV at PU 200; A1 upper edge 4.7-6.6 keV) and, without PU, sep_IT^det and w_core; sep_IT^det NOT MEASURABLE at PU 200.
